title: censored-gp-santa-barbara: code and analytical data for "Bayesian geostatistics with censored data for mapping heavy-metal soil contamination around the Santa Bárbara mine (Huancavelica, Peru)"
description: Code and analytical data supporting the article "Bayesian geostatistics with censored data for mapping heavy-metal soil contamination around the Santa Bárbara mine (Huancavelica, Peru)", submitted to Stochastic Environmental Research and Risk Assessment. The archive contains the Bayesian censored Gaussian-process pipeline (PyMC with nutpie), the analytical dataset (114 locations, 10 analytes, data/final/santa_barbara_soil.csv), the article figures and tables, and the reproducibility evidence behind the checks reported in the supplementary material (outputs/serra_r1/ and outputs/serra_r2/). In addition to the repository, this Zenodo record includes the scanned source report, OEFA Informe N.° 00341-2018-OEFA/DEAM-STEC, obtained through a public-records request (Ley N.° 27806, case file 2026-E01-114527); the scanned report is an OEFA document and is not covered by the MIT licence of the code. Documentation in Spanish: README_es.md.
